author: DamiLee
description:
They built it without compasses, lasers, or GPS. Just the stars, and somehow ended up within 1/15th of a degree of true north.

The Great Pyramid isn't a miracle. It's the last step in a long, slow, obsessive learning curve, each pyramid before it a failed attempt, a correction, a step closer to something that still doesn't feel fully explainable.

2.3 million blocks. A base so level it's off by centimeters across the whole thing. A slope so precise that any variation would have collapsed the entire structure at the top.

And then there's the latitude coincidence. The speed of light. The Earth's curvature ratio. The theories that pile on top of each other until the whole thing feels like it couldn't possibly be human.

But here's the part nobody says out loud: that same latitude also runs through a Subway in Louisiana.

A lot of things line up when you're looking hard enough for them to.

title: The Genius of the Great Pyramid's Architecture
